description: If k(i)<l(i), each diagonal coordinate lies below l(i).ord, and the diagonal differs from every image of the tagged sum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteSumsAndProducts.konigDiagonal_spec.{u} {ι : Type u} (k l : ι → Cardinal.{u})
  (h : ∀ (i : ι), k i < l i) (F : (i : ι) × (k i).ord.ToType → (i : ι) → (l i).ord.ToType) :
  (∀ (i : ι), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteSumsAndProducts.konigDiagonal k l F i < (l i).ord) ∧
    ∀ (x : (i : ι) × (k i).ord.ToType),
      ∃ i, ↑(F x i).toOrd ≠ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteSumsAndProducts.konigDiagonal k l F i
